Puerto Vallarta — Dad’s 80th Birthday

Nuevo Vallarta / Bucerías

Walking here is the beach itself — long, flat sand. No town malecón.

Marival Emotions Resort & Suites

$$

3 pickleball courts with equipment included, shuffleboard, 6 pools, 7 restaurants, beachfront, about 20 minutes from the airport. Big lively family resort.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 54% off, or a free 5th night on 5+ night suite stays. April dates are covered. Book by Thu Nov 26.

Visit resort →

Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit

$$$$$

4 pickleball courts, best food of the bunch, all suites with big terraces, beachfront, about 20 minutes from the airport. Upscale and quiet. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Black Friday: 20% off Grand Class and Family suites, plus spa and golf perks. Book by Thu Dec 3. April dates look clear — confirm at booking.

Visit resort →

Paradise Village Beach Resort and Spa

$

Pickleball at the on-site El Tigre racquet club, shuffleboard, 900 ft of beach, next to the marina and shops so the best walking of the Nuevo resorts. All-suite, condo-style. (Room-only rate shown; all-inclusive is an add-on.)

Current promotion: Stay Longer, Save More: 35% off the all-inclusive plan on 7+ night stays. Book by Sun Dec 20.

Visit resort →

Marival Distinct All-Suites & World Spa

$$$

1 pickleball court (reservation only), spa-focused, quieter and more grown-up feel than its sister resort next door. Shuffleboard is at the sister resort, a short walk away.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 54% off penthouses, villas and Premier suites, or a free 5th night on 5+ night stays. April dates are covered. Book by Thu Nov 26.

Visit resort →

Occidental Nuevo Vallarta

$$

Pickleball on one outdoor court with equipment on site, plus shuffleboard — beachfront all-inclusive family resort in Nuevo Vallarta, next door to the Hard Rock (confirm the court’s exact spot on the grounds at booking).

Current promotion: Black Friday: extra 15% off with code 26BF15. Book by Sun Nov 29; travel through Jun 30 — April is covered.

Visit resort →

Puerto Vallarta Proper

Puerto Vallarta has the real downtown malecón — a paved seaside promenade, great for daily walks. Resorts here are 5–15 minutes from the airport.

Secrets Vallarta Bay

$$$$

Pickleball and shuffleboard, adults-only, 10–15 minutes from the malecón.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership), plus suite, cabana and spa extras on April stays. Book by Mon Nov 23.

Visit resort →

Dreams Vallarta Bay Resort & Spa

$$$

Pickleball, no shuffleboard, family resort, 10–15 minutes from the malecón and the airport.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership). Book by Mon Nov 23. The extra suite and spa perks don’t apply here.

Visit resort →

Melia Puerto Vallarta

$

Pickleball (8 courts) and shuffleboard, 5 minutes from the airport, 10 minutes from the malecón. Note: a local club uses the courts on weekday mornings, so afternoons are the safe bet.

Current promotion: Meliá’s Black Friday sale runs to Sun Nov 29 with up to 50% off — worth checking this hotel is included.

Visit resort →

Hyatt Ziva Puerto Vallarta

$$$

3 outdoor pickleball courts, 5 minutes from the malecón (closest of any resort on the list), private cove beach. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership) — book by Mon Nov 23. Flight + hotel packages save up to $500 with code BLKFRI26C, book by Thu Dec 3.

Visit resort →

The Westin Playa Vallarta

$$$

Pickleball and padel courts, newest all-inclusive of the bunch (opened May 2026), minutes from the airport and downtown. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Marriott Cyber Week opens Tue Nov 24: 25% off in the app, 15% on the website — book by Tue Dec 1. A separate 20%-off Black Friday deal opens Fri Nov 27, book by Fri Dec 4. Both cover April stays.

Visit resort →

Velas Vallarta Suite Resort

$$

2 pickleball courts, all-suite, about 10 minutes from the malecón. No shuffleboard, and reviewers mention timeshare sales pressure.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 20% off selected rooms, plus a $300 resort credit per suite stay. Book by Thu Dec 3. April dates look clear — confirm at booking.

Visit resort →

Further afield

Both have pickleball, both are a drive from the malecón — Garza Blanca south of downtown, Bahia Mita up in Punta de Mita.

Garza Blanca Preserve Resort & Spa

$$$$$

Outdoor pickleball and basketball courts, plus squash, at a luxury all-suite resort on a jungle hillside above a swimmable beach, south of downtown. All-inclusive is an add-on, not the default rate. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Black Friday: every third night free, plus up to 50% off select rates. Book by today, Sun Nov 22 — the resort's own Black Friday page ends bookings today (its booking engine shows Dec 7 for other rates).

Visit resort →

Secrets Bahia Mita Surf & Spa

$$$$$

3 pickleball courts shared with the adjoining Dreams Bahia Mita, adults-only, in Punta de Mita about 50 minutes from the airport. All-inclusive, with free-flow access to Dreams next door. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Members save up to 25% (20% without membership). Book by Mon Nov 23. The extra suite and spa perks don’t apply here.

Visit resort →

Barceló Puerto Vallarta

$$

Pickleball on the multi-sport court (portable nets — confirm paddles and nets at booking), family resort on Mismaloya Beach south of downtown, 4 pools, all suites, jungle mountains behind the beach. No shuffleboard.

Current promotion: Black Friday: up to 55% off with code 26BF15. Book by Thu Dec 3; stays through Dec 30 — April is covered.

Visit resort →

Left off the list: Villa del Palmar in Puerto Vallarta — cheapest, but it’s mid-rebuild with amenities disappearing, so we’re skipping it.
